name: main-integration-via-merge-gate-only
body: Law (prose; assessed by review): the navigator never holds a raw git grant that can rewrite a branch ref (create, force-move, delete, or rename), merge into, check out, switch, or add/remove worktrees on the main checkout. Its grant set is exactly `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git worktree list *`, and `git rebase *`. In particular a blanket `git branch *` violates this law: `git branch -f main <sha>` force-moves main's ref past the verify gate, and `git branch -D` / `git branch -m` delete or rename refs. A change-set reaches main only through `apg project merge` and its verify gate. `git rebase` is used only inside the project worktree.
